metadata.target_role: Senior Product Manager - Product Adoption, Insights & AI

profile_summary: Senior Product Manager and enterprise strategy leader with 10+ years of experience driving platform adoption, operational analytics, AI-enabled agentic workflows, and cross-functional product execution across enterprise infrastructure, SaaS, and digital platforms. Proven ability to partner with engineering, operations, GTM, and VP/CXO stakeholders to define multi-quarter roadmaps, build KPI and adoption frameworks, and translate complex data into actionable insights. Track record of delivering measurable value realization across Lowe’s India and Byju’s, including 99.99% platform reliability, ~$10M in annual revenue protection, $2M in lifecycle cost savings, and 35% conversion growth.

sub_bullets: Owned enterprise platform strategy and execution across engineering and operations teams by establishing reliability governance and automated workflows, ensuring 99.99% reliability for core business platforms

Designed KPI frameworks and executive dashboards tracking platform adoption, incident resolution, operational efficiency, and cost savings to deliver actionable insights for VP/CXO reviews and roadmap prioritization
Defined annual and quarterly product roadmaps by aligning engineering, operations, and business stakeholders around reliability and adoption priorities, targeting a 20% reduction in incident volume

Led revenue protection initiatives by deploying automated recovery agents and intelligent incident-handling workflows to proactively mitigate operational risks, reducing order cancellations and saving ~$10M annually

Drove cross-functional stakeholder alignment and enablement across product, engineering, finance, and IT teams by establishing operating rhythms and KPI review cadences that accelerated enterprise platform adoption

Coordinated end-to-end operational planning and service governance across procurement, asset lifecycle, and infrastructure teams by translating stakeholder requirements into scalable workflow improvements

Spearheaded a unified enterprise asset lifecycle platform by partnering with finance, infrastructure, and operations stakeholders to centralize visibility and optimize resource utilization, delivering $2M in annual cost savings

Designed and launched an AI-driven procurement and catalog platform featuring agentic workflows that streamlined store setup orchestration and guided user adoption, reducing operational cycle times by 20%
